name: Teens Reach (San Jose Public Library teen council)
what_you_do: Teens ages 13 to 18 help with library programs (like kids crafts), sign up kids for Summer Learning and speak up as library advisors. Earn community service hours.
who_can_apply: Ages 13 to 18. You need a strong interest in the library, and you must go to meetings and join in activities.
deadline_text: Each branch has its own sign-up. No single deadline.
how_to_apply: Find your branch's Teens Reach sign-up on BetterImpact or ask the branch. Volunteer Services: 408-808-2181, volunteer.sjpl@sjlibrary.org.
notes: Meeting times differ by branch (for example Rose Garden Thursdays 4 p.m., Almaden Tuesdays 4:30 p.m.). Other SJPL teen roles include Teen Book Reviewer. TeenHQ is at the King Library, 150 E San Fernando.
